doc: Motion blur: box average of the premultiplied rgba along a line through each pixel, total streak length `length` px centred on the pixel, direction `angle` degrees (0 = horizontal, clockwise on screen). Long streaks stay a smooth, exact box: pass 0 is a box of width a = length / N (<= 32 bilinear taps, spacing <= 1 px), pass 1 is a comb of N = ceil(length / 32) taps spaced a px apart; box (*) comb = one box of width length. At most 32 + 13 taps per pixel at any length. Quality: the continuous box is sampled with bilinear taps at <= 1 px spacing, so the result matches an ideal box blur to ~1/255 on smooth content; for lengths below 1 px the streak is a 2-tap bilinear box.
